verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Card-create API call and cardholder creation, plus sandbox simulation before going live (stripe-issuing-docs-1, stripe-issuing-docs-3, stripe-issuing-docs-10), but nothing in the evidence explicitly confirms PAN/CVV/expiry are returned synchronously in that same call. More importantly, community reports directly contradict the 'no sales cycle' claim: Issuing has historically been invitation-only, with users needing to email a Stripe employee and wait for approval batches before being allowed to go live (stripe-issuing-comm-5, stripe-issuing-comm-9), which is itself a sales/vetting gate. Missing for 10: explicit doc evidence that PAN/CVV/expiry are returned in the create response, and confirmation that the invitation gate has been removed for self-serve sandbox-to-live flow.
